items.text: Brock Bowers doubtful (knee) vs Chargers after limited Friday practice; Raiders will test pregame but treat as out. McConkey practiced and Q.
items.why: Knee (post-meniscus); limited Friday after missing earlier sessions.
items.implication: Mayer elevated for TE volume; do not hold out healthy early TEs hoping for GTD.
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer routes/targets surge if inactive.

items.text: Chargers list WR Ladd McConkey questionable (ribs) after limited Friday practice return; biggest slate uncertainty per Levitan, impacts Herbert projections. Late window game.
items.why: Rib injury; missed Wed/Thu, limited Fri.
items.implication: Herbert/WR corps volatility; roster Tre' Harris contingency; lower floor if plays.
items.opportunity: If OUT: Quentin Johnston/Tre' Harris target spike; Herbert pass volume may shift.

items.text: Texans ruled out WR Nico Collins due to hamstring injury for Sunday vs Bengals; corroborated across multiple reports after missing practices.
items.why: Hamstring; missed Thu/Fri practices; official ruling.
items.implication: Houston WR crumbs; elevate Schultz/Hutchinson/Boutte volume; stream TE Schultz.
items.opportunity: Targets/routes shift to remaining HOU pass-catchers; TE streamer boost.

items.text: Ravens list WR Zay Flowers as doubtful (hamstring) for Sunday vs Saints; limited Friday return but prepare as out. Ja'Kobi Lane also out.
items.why: Hamstring; limited practice Friday after earlier absences.
items.implication: BAL WR hierarchy crumbs; Bateman/Andrews target boost; start as if out.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets to Bateman, Andrews; reverse if unexpectedly active.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson listed IN for 2026 debut; Patriots need playmakers—Levitan asks if they give him 10+ touches vs Stevenson. Full practice, ready.
items.why: Ankle cleared; full practice; said ready.
items.implication: Potential 10+ touch role in debut amid NE need for playmakers; monitor split with Stevenson.
items.opportunity: Carries/routes expansion possible; handcuff/upside play if volume materializes.
items.conflict: May not reclaim full work immediately; Stevenson held 60/71 snaps W1.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) is biggest injury on the slate; affects so many projections including Justin Herbert. Game at 4pm ET. BAL/HOU/NE down to WR crumbs.
items.why: Ribs Q status cascades to Herbert and supporting cast projections.
items.implication: Monitor closely; update projections immediately on news; Herbert floor risk.
items.opportunity: If McConkey out, secondary LAC WRs and Herbert adjustment.

items.text: Alvin Kamara listed IN/cleared for debut vs BAL; Etienne preferred RB3 as committee likely with Miller; cautious on full Kamara workload.
items.implication: Squeezes Etienne passing role; three-headed potential; Etienne still preferred short-term.
items.opportunity: Kamara receiving/third-down if eased in; reverse Etienne beneficiaries if full work.
items.conflict: Usage may be limited on return; Etienne W1 receiving control.

items.text: AJ Brown listed OUT or DOUBTFUL (ankle/IR context) in ETR Sunday injuries; NE/pass-catcher crumbs noted by Levitan.
items.implication: NE WR room thin; elevate remaining playmakers.
items.opportunity: Targets to other NE receivers if any volume.

items.text: Bengals list QB Joe Burrow questionable (back) but he said he will play; full Friday practice and coach indication trending toward active vs Texans.
items.why: Back tightness; said playing; full Fri practice.
items.implication: Start Burrow/Chase/Higgins/Brown normally; no major downgrade despite tough matchup.
items.opportunity: Full CIN offense volume if active as expected.

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE: 21/24 RB touches through 3Q (74% snaps), 40% routes targeted (team lead), vs IND who gave 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry. Massive season range incl RB1 overall.
items.why: Elite W1 usage (24% tgt share, high util); soft IND run matchup.
items.implication: Start with confidence as RB4+; upside for RB1 week/season.
items.opportunity: 24%+ target share + lead back role + matchup.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE: 99 utilization score W1 (tied Bijan lead), 19% target share last 10 games, 25+ touches in 3/4 recent; @ LAC soft defense.
items.why: Elite util/volume under Kubiak; passing-game involvement sustained.
items.implication: RB8 start with upside; overreaction to prior injury scare fading.

items.text: Giving Christian McCaffrey a bump off Week 1 usage regardless, but Kaelon Black (groin) status does matter for SF backfield.
items.why: Week 1 usage data supports bump; Black Q impacts depth.
items.implication: CMC elevated confidence; monitor Black for any committee risk.

items.text: Bucky Irving LOVE: W1 util RB9, 26% target share, 100% RB RZ touches, out-routed Gainwell by 8; vs CLE who allowed 121 rush/4.8 YPC.
items.why: Passing + RZ monopoly confirmed; favorable CLE matchup.
items.implication: RB17 with RB2 upside; trust the util/RZ role.

items.text: Travis Etienne HATE: matched Miller rushes W1, 69% pts via air; Kamara return squeezes role as underdogs @ BAL. Marvin Harrison Jr HATE: 8% tgt share W1 (5th on team), zero RZ, tough SEA.
items.why: Etienne: Kamara squeeze + script; MHJ: low share + matchup.
items.implication: Fade Etienne as RB25 range; sit/fade MHJ despite name.
items.opportunity: Negative for both; reverse Etienne if Kamara limited.
items.conflict: Kamara IN may further pressure Etienne.
